role: The abstract base of glass, stained glass and ice: a full-cube block whose only behavior is hiding faces against a same-meta neighbour when its flag says so.

members.name: BlockBreakable
members.note: The flag lands in the registry entries: 20 and 95 are glass (flag false), 79 is ice.

members.name: field_149996_a
members.note: False for all three subclasses (glass 20, stained glass 95, ice 79), so each hides a face against its own block: render_blocks.c should_side_be_rendered's cases 20/95 and 79.

members.name: shouldSideBeRendered
members.note: should_side_be_rendered: glass and stained glass draw the face whenever the neighbour's metadata differs from their own (whatever the neighbour is), otherwise hide it against the same block; ice hides it against ice; the rest is Block's. mv_glass pins cubes, lines, 16 colours stacked, glass beside stained glass of the same metadata, glass beside stone and an ice pair; without the glass case the views measure 720 to 11,315 px over 25 (39 to 690 with it).

notes: The subclasses are BlockGlass (20) and BlockStainedGlass (95) in blocks.h, with BlockIce (79) as the third; BlockPortal also extends it but overrides shouldSideBeRendered whole. The glass branch (the Blocks.glass / Blocks.stained_glass test in the base method) was ported by lane/meshvar; out/java/rendertick/mv_glass is its scene (8 views mv_glass_*, meshes vertex exact).
